title: 第13章 为了未来我暂时放弃了双修第14章 圣女宫以后是我的后宫
content_zh:
我用了一次“入梦”的机会，预感了自己的未来。
结果显示，我的未来只剩50年！
这正好和圣女宫弟子飞过来的时间吻合。
就算这个“未来”只是一种概率，也意味着我大概率会在50年后，被圣女宫弟子斩杀！
第二天，我又预感了一次。
结果还是一样！
我不会束手等死，我要去改变这个“未来”，至少要把所有可能都尝试一遍。
现在实力是最没用的，再强大也打不过圣女宫那些弟子。
我只能把希望寄托在“玄学”上。
我给美女器灵起了个名字，叫师婧珏。
“珏”是双玉合璧的意思，既希望她能与我心灵契合、共渡劫难，也盼着能帮她找到“纯阳”的另一半。
要唤醒她，我首先想到了同为器灵的婧容、婧纯、婧馨、婧露和婧舞。
可她们五人都是我的本命神器的器灵，婧珏却是外来器灵。
虽说双方都是高等文明制造的“机械灵体”，但可能属于不同的文明体系，没法类比参考。
我做了些实验，发现差异确实很大。
婧容她们都能和我双修，至少有个效果——激活“翌恒调息”后，我能把她们拉入我的灵体小世界。
可婧珏不行，只能激活“翌恒调息”，根本拉不动她。
……
双舞和她师父通了次话，回来后，陪我缠绵了七天七夜。
“哥哥，加入我仙女宫吧。”双舞犹豫着说出建议，“按我们和圣女宫的协议，双方弟子不能互相厮杀。”

仙女宫虽说是我认定的邪教，但只要能活下去，我也不介意暂且低头。
“需要我做什么？”
“变成女人！”
我沉默了片刻，没有明确拒绝。
现在科技这么发达，基因重塑不过是一次细胞重组的流程而已。
等躲过这一劫，我再变回来就行。
“具体要怎么做？”
“修炼一种功法。”
“不是做一次手术？”
“灵体和灵体本源也要一起变。”
“啊？！还能变回来吗？”
双舞摇了摇头：“没听说过。”
“不行。”我果断拒绝，“我现在相当于有500多万双修伴侣，每个人都是一份承诺，我不能背弃她们的信任。”
……
修炼提升层次，我也没有完全放弃。
不过不是我自己修炼，而是让菁秀修炼。
她是四属性灵体，要是能修炼到较高层次，完全可以碾压三属性灵体。
我特意研究了“五行融合”的修炼阵。
按之前大家了解的情况，组阵需要840人，得是同族血脉、同性别，且修炼层次相近才行。
不光菁秀没法靠这个加速，馥蜜、菁缨她们也不行。

现在能满足条件的，只有双修宫和玉女宫的弟子。
恰巧那几天，第二枚灵宠蛋孵化出来了，果然又是个大美女，同样和我共生。
我给她起名叫师菁妍，人如其名，妍姿艳质，正合我心意。
她没有激活灵体，但膻中穴上有个圆形的粉红色印记，像一只展翅的凤凰，应该是某种传承印记。
她与我共生后，赋予了我内息洞察的能力——能感知自身和他人的内息运转状态，就像传说中的“开天眼”，我称之为“内视”。
content_en:
I took the opportunity of "dreaming" to have a premonition of my future.
The results show that I only have 50 years left in my future!
This coincides with the time when the disciples of the Holy Maiden Palace flew over.
Even if this "future" is just a probability, it also means that there is a high probability that I will be killed by the disciples of the Saintess' Palace in 50 years!
The next day, I had another premonition.
The result is still the same!
I will not wait for death, I will change this "future", at least try all possibilities.
Now the strength is the most useless, no matter how strong it is, it can't beat the disciples of the Holy Lady's Palace.
I can only place my hope on "metaphysics".
I gave the beautiful weapon spirit a name, Shi Jingjue.
"Jue" means two jade in a jade. I not only hope that she can be in harmony with me and overcome the disaster together, but also hope that I can help her find the other half of "Pure Yang".
To wake her up, I first thought of Jingrong, Jingchun, Jingxin, Jinglu and Jingwu who are also weapon spirits.
But all five of them are the weapon spirits of my natal artifact, but Jingjue is an alien weapon spirit.
Although both sides are "mechanical spirits" created by advanced civilizations, they may belong to different civilization systems and cannot be compared and referenced.
I did some experiments and found a really big difference.
Jingrong and the others can practice dual cultivation with me, and at least there is an effect - after activating "Yi Heng Pranayama", I can pull them into my small spiritual world.
But Jingjue couldn't do it. He could only activate "Yiheng Breath Adjustment", which couldn't pull her back at all.
…
Shuangwu talked to her master once, and after she came back, she stayed with me for seven days and seven nights.
"Brother, join me in the Fairy Palace." Shuang Wu hesitated and suggested, "According to our agreement with the Holy Lady Palace, disciples from both sides cannot fight each other."
Although Fairy Palace is what I consider a cult, as long as I can survive, I don’t mind bowing my head for the time being.
"What do you need me to do?"
"Become a woman!"
I was silent for a moment without explicitly saying no.
Nowadays, technology is so advanced that genetic remodeling is just a process of cell reorganization.
Once I escape this disaster, I can change back again.
"How to do it exactly?"
"Practice a skill."
"Isn't it an operation?"
"The spiritual body and the origin of the spiritual body must also change together."
"Ah?! Can you still change back?"
Shuangwu shook his head: "I haven't heard of it."
"No." I refused decisively, "I now have more than 5 million dual-cultivation partners. Each one of them is a promise. I can't betray their trust."
…
I haven’t completely given up on cultivating myself to improve my level.
But instead of me practicing it myself, I let Jingxiu practice it.
She is a four-attribute spirit body. If she can cultivate to a higher level, she can completely crush the three-attribute spirit body.
I specially studied the "Five Elements Fusion" cultivation array.
According to what everyone has learned before, 840 people are needed to form the formation. They must be of the same bloodline, same gender, and have similar cultivation levels.
Not only Jingxiu couldn't speed up with this, but neither could Fumi and Jingying.
The only ones who can meet the conditions now are the disciples of Shuangxiu Palace and Jade Girl Palace.
It just so happened that in those few days, the second spiritual pet egg hatched, and it turned out to be another beautiful woman, who also lived with me.
I named her Shi Jingyan. She is just like her name, and she is beautiful and beautiful, which is exactly what I want.
She did not activate her spirit body, but there was a round pink mark on the Tanzhong acupoint, like a phoenix spreading its wings, which should be some kind of inheritance mark.
After she coexisted with me, she gave me the ability to see the inner breath - the ability to perceive the inner breath operation status of myself and others, just like the legendary "eyes in the sky", which I call "inner vision".
